What we teach

Three arts.
One gym.

Boxing, K1 kickboxing and Kyokushin karate under one roof — coached properly, for fitness, confidence and real self-defence. Kids, teens and adults all train here.

01 / BOXING

Boxing

Mon · Wed · Fri — 6pm

Real boxing skills — footwork, pad work and bag rounds. Learn to move, punch and defend properly, whatever your level.

Enquire →
02 / K1 KICKBOXING

K1 Kickboxing

Tue & Thu — 6pm

K1 striking — punches, kicks and knees, drilled hard and coached right. Build power, fitness and sharp technique.

Enquire →
03 / KYOKUSHIN KARATE

Kyokushin Karate

Part of the weekly programme

Traditional Kyokushin karate — discipline, kata and full-contact spirit. The art that built the gym's foundations.

Enquire →
04 / KIDS 8–12

Kids Classes

Wednesdays — 5:15pm

Boxing and kickboxing for ages 8–12. Build confidence, improve focus, respect others — and stay fit and strong.

Enquire →
The coach

Artur Aniolowski
Founder & head coach

30+ years in combat sports. Artur has spent three decades training and coaching boxing, kickboxing and karate — and brings the same discipline to every class, from a child's first session to a fighter's camp.

15+ years in the military and law enforcement. As a close protection operative, door supervisor and private investigator, he teaches real-world skills — not just sport.
